#!/bin/bash

# Backup Script for Markdown Files
# This script copies all .md files from the current directory to a backup directory

# Define the backup directory
BACKUP_DIR="/tmp/mcp-workspace/backup"

# Create the backup directory if it doesn't exist
if [ ! -d "$BACKUP_DIR" ]; then
    echo "Creating backup directory: $BACKUP_DIR"
    mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR"
    echo "Backup directory created successfully."
else
    echo "Backup directory already exists: $BACKUP_DIR"
fi

# Copy all .md files from /tmp/mcp-workspace to the backup directory
echo "Starting backup of .md files..."
cd /tmp/mcp-workspace

# Count files before backup
md_count=$(find . -maxdepth 1 -name "*.md" -type f | wc -l)
echo "Found $md_count .md files to backup."

# Copy all .md files
cp -v *.md "$BACKUP_DIR/" 2>/dev/null

# Check if copy was successful
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Backup completed successfully!"
    echo "All .md files have been copied to $BACKUP_DIR"
    
    # Display backup directory contents
    echo ""
    echo "Backup directory contents:"
    ls -lh "$BACKUP_DIR"/*.md | wc -l
    echo "files backed up."
else
    echo "Error: Backup failed!"
    exit 1
fi

BACKUP_DIR="/tmp/mcp-workspace/backup"
SOURCE_DIR="/tmp/mcp-workspace"

    mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR"
    echo "Backup directory created successfully."
else
    echo "Backup directory already exists: $BACKUP_DIR"
fi

# Initialize log file

echo "Source: $SOURCE_DIR" >> "$LOG_FILE"
echo "Destination: $BACKUP_DIR" >> "$LOG_FILE"

# Copy all .md files from /tmp/mcp-workspace to the backup directory

echo "Found $md_count .md files to backup." >> "$LOG_FILE"

    echo "Backup completed successfully!" >> "$LOG_FILE"
    echo "All .md files have been copied to $BACKUP_DIR" >> "$LOG_FILE"

    echo ""
    echo "Backup log saved to: $LOG_FILE"
else
    echo "Error: Backup failed!" >> "$LOG_FILE"

    exit 1
